champions.tldr: Innate: Periodically, Naafiri summons a Packmate that fights alongside her. She may have up to 2–3 Packmates at a time. Naafiri summons the maximum number of Packmates when the game starts and upon respawning.; Hittin…
champions.gameplayImpact: Naafiri is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Periodically, Naafiri summons a Packmate that fights alongside her. She may have up to 2–3 Packmates at a time. Naafiri summons the maximum number of Packmates when the game starts and upon respawning.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hitting champions or large monsters with abilities reduces the cooldown by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 second.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Static Cooldown: 25–10 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Naafiri hurls a dagger in the target direction that deals 35–75 (+ 20% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies hit and inflicts them with a bleed|buzzword3 for 5 seconds, which deals 30/10 to 170/10 (+ 80/10% bonus AD) bonus physical damage every 0.5 seconds over the duration. Darkin Daggers can be recast after 0.5 seconds and within 4 seconds at no additional cost.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If the dagger hits a target that is already bleeding|buzzword3, they are instead the remaining bleed|buzzword3 damage plus 35–95 (+ 70% bonus AD) additional bonus physical damage|physical damage, with the base bonus damage increased by 0–100% (over 0–100)|health and the scaling for the bonus damage increased by 0–250% (over 0–100)|health. If that target is also a champion or large monster, Naafiri heal herself for 45–125 (+ 40% bonus AD).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Naafiri mimics the first cast's effects.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Darkin Daggers deals 70% damage against minions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Mana Cost: 55–75.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 11–7 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: 0.25 seconds, Target Range: cr 900, Width: er 50.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Naafiri channel for 0.75 seconds to true sight out the target enemy champion. Upon completion, the target is standard sight for 1.5 seconds and Naafiri and her We Are More|Packmates}} dash to the target, each colliding with the first enemy champion hit. Upon impact, Naafiri deals 30–190 (+ 80% bonus AD) physical damage and slows the target by 99% for 0.25 seconds, while Packmates deal 10% of that damage to their own targets.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Packmates become untargetable during their windup and dash, and can individually damage targets.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hounds' Pursuit refunds 50% of its cooldown if the channel is cancelled.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Mana Cost: 70–30.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 22–14 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: None, Target Range: cr 20px.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Naafiri dash in the target direction and deals 35–115 (+ 70% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal 65–225 (+ 100% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: We Are More|Packmates}} vanish during the dash and blink near Naafiri on her arrival. They are also heal to full health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Mana Cost: 35.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 11–9 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: None, Target Range: , Collision Radius: er 50, Effect Radius: .

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Passive: Hounds' Pursuit}} gains 80–240 (3 ranks) bonus cast range.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Naafiri prepares her grand hunt, immediately despawning all active We Are More|Packmates}} then summoning the maximum number of new ones along with 2–4 (3 ranks) extra Packmates. She grants herself and all Packmates 35–50 (3 ranks)% bonus movement speed that decays over 4 seconds and is doubled while out-of-combat. She also grants sight of the surrounding area for 2 seconds, and standard sight nearby enemy champions for 4 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Naafiri goes on the hunt for 15 seconds, during which she gains 10–30 (3 ranks) (+ 15–25 (3 ranks)% AD) bonus attack damage, increases the maximum health of all her Packmates by 25%, and reduces the total cooldown of We Are More}} by 50%. Her first basic attack or ability hit against a champion will grant her a shield for 125–525 (3 ranks) (+ 50% bonus AD) for 3 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Naafiri's first champion takedown within the duration refreshes all effects of The Call of the Pack, restores all Packmates to full health, and grants Naafiri the same shield again, though not stacking with the first one. When the hunt ends, any extra Packmates are despawned and all other ones are restored to full health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 120–100 (3 ranks) seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: 0.75 seconds, Effect Radius: Sight / cr .
